content.title: About
content.content: Decaffeinated, nonfat cappuccino is a beverage made from roasted coffee beans that have had the caffeine removed and skimmed milk. It retains the characteristic coffee aroma and creamy texture while providing minimal calories and virtually no fat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Caffeine is removed by a water‑based extraction process that preserves most flavor compounds.
Nonfat milk creates a lighter drink but still allows a stable foam thanks to added emulsifiers.
Traditional cappuccino is served in a 150–180 ml cup with equal parts espresso, steamed milk, and milk foam.
Decaf coffees often use Arabica beans because their milder flavor survives the decaffeination process better.
In some countries, decaf cappuccino is finished with a sprinkle of cinnamon or cocoa powder for extra aroma.

items.title: Low Calorie Content
items.content: Skimmed milk and the absence of caffeine make this drink suitable for calorie‑restricted diets.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Coffee retains polyphenols that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Digestive Comfort
items.content: Without caffeine, the beverage is gentler on the stomach for people with sensitivity.

items.title: Reduced Cardiovascular Risk
items.content: Studies associate moderate coffee consumption, including decaf, with a lower risk of heart disease.

items.title: Mood Enhancement
items.content: The aromatic profile of coffee stimulates serotonin production even without caffeine.

items.title: Acid Sensitivity
items.content: Coffee remains acidic and may cause discomfort for those with gastritis or reflux.

items.title: Milk Allergy
items.content: Skimmed milk can trigger allergic reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: Residues from Decaffeination
items.content: Some decaffeination methods use solvents; choose products labeled “natural decaffeination” to minimize exposure.

content.title: How to Enjoy
content.content: Serve the decaf cappuccino hot, immediately after preparation to preserve the foam. A pinch of cinnamon, nutmeg, or a small amount of sweetener can be added to taste.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep ground decaf coffee in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. Skimmed milk should be used within 5–7 days after opening.
